investigation_notes.Description: An unusually high volume of SharePoint file downloads was observed for user Jaanus.Tamm@globalcorp.ee, totaling 985 items in a 24-hour window compared to a baseline of 50. The activity targets a SharePoint site at https://globalcorp.sharepoint.com/sites/Strategy_and_Growth/ and includes sensitive-looking sample files. The volume and scope suggest potential data exfiltration, though legitimate business needs could explain a large project download; given the potential for leakage of sensitive information, this is treated as High Priority pending verification of user intent and data classification.
